name: dmengine-fumo-download-update-multi-invalid-result
description: Mode C multi-component combined FUMO invalid result: the mock sends Exec on ./ManagedObjects/FUMO/DownloadAndUpdate and serves the 291-byte two-component/three-update DP. The engine downloads it, advances FUMO state 30 -> 40 -> 60, hands event 77 to the OEM handler and receives lab result 0. validateResultCode remaps it to UNDEFINED(409); the engine reports the failure and returns to idle without success state 90. The result is lab-supplied and the package is structural; no physical install is claimed.
